record.question: Call him in.
record.explanation: Let him be called in is the conventional passive imperative: be called retains the action and in retains its particle. It is the best conversion of the original command. He must be called in is also passive but changes the imperative into a declarative statement of necessity; the other alternatives are active or omit call. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/let; https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/active-passive-voice
